items.title_zh: 实时EEG脑机接口后端项目
bullets_zh: GitHub项目Ixzu-12/Real-Time-EEG-Brain-Computer-Interface-BCI提供实时连续EEG处理后端。
它结合少样本迁移学习与DSP，解码物理运动想象以驱动真实硬件。
发布于2026-09-19，作为高级非侵入式EEG BCI软件项目具有相关性。
bullets_en: GitHub project Ixzu-12/Real-Time-EEG-Brain-Computer-Interface-BCI provides a backend for live continuous EEG processing.
It combines few-shot transfer learning and DSP to decode physical motor imagery for real-world hardware actuation.
Published 2026-09-19, it is relevant as an advanced non-invasive EEG BCI software project.
items.brief: 开源实时EEG BCI后端，用于运动想象解码与硬件控制。
items.brief_en: Open-source real-time EEG BCI backend for motor-imagery decoding and hardware control.
items.raw_excerpt: Backend neuro-engineering system for live continuous EEG processing. Uses Few-Shot Transfer Learning and DSP to decode physical motor imagery for real-world hardware actuation.

items.title_en: ADS1299-Core-SDK: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI Hardware and Software Ecosystem
bullets_zh: GitHub项目yuguoyu123456/ADS1299-Core-SDK面向基于ADS1299的EEG/BCI系统，提供8-64通道硬件与参考包。
它包含MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA支持、Verilog RTL、PC/移动/Linux集成以及Python/MATLAB/R分析流程。
该条目发布于2026-09-19，是面向非侵入式EEG采集、验证、教学与研究的开放生态。
bullets_en: GitHub project yuguoyu123456/ADS1299-Core-SDK targets ADS1299-based EEG/BCI systems with 8-64 channel hardware and reference packages.
It includes MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA support, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, and Python/MATLAB/R analysis workflows.
Published 2026-09-19 as an open ecosystem for non-invasive EEG acquisition, validation, education, and research.
items.brief: 面向非侵入式EEG的ADS1299开源硬件与软件栈，覆盖采集到分析。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem spanning hardware, firmware, integration, and analysis for non-invasive BCI development.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

bullets_zh: GitHub仓库neowalter/neoxai收录BCI/EEG开放数据集、模型、处理方法及归档新闻论文。
它通过集中可复用资源支持非侵入式EEG BCI研究。
该条目发布于2026-09-20，是社区维护索引而非单一数据集。
bullets_en: GitHub repository neowalter/neoxai curates BCI/EEG open datasets, models, processing methods, and archived news/papers.
It supports non-invasive EEG-based BCI research by centralizing reusable resources.
Published 2026-09-20 as a community-maintained index rather than a single dataset.

items.title_zh: 基于PhysioNet eegmmidb的EEG运动想象ERD分析
items.title_en: EEG Motor Imagery ERD Analysis from PhysioNet eegmmidb
bullets_zh: GitHub仓库AadithyaSairam/eeg-motor-imagery分析想象手部运动时mu节律的事件相关去同步。
它使用PhysioNet的eegmmidb数据，这是标准非侵入式运动想象EEG数据集。
该条目发布于2026-09-19，是面向EEG BCI信号处理的教学示例。
bullets_en: GitHub repository AadithyaSairam/eeg-motor-imagery analyzes event-related desynchronization of the mu rhythm during imagined hand movement.
It uses PhysioNet EEG data from eegmmidb, a standard non-invasive motor-imagery dataset.
Published 2026-09-19 as an educational example for EEG-based BCI signal processing.
